character_book.name: The Universe- Ruell
character_book.description: Ruell is the name of the universe, in which the Angel, Demon, and Earth Realms reside.

entries.name: Angels
entries.content:
Angels are beings who reside in the Realm of Light, Vak Lumen, also called the Angel Realm.

They are immortal, immensely powerful beings who utilize light as their main source of power. All Angels have the ability to heal themselves and others via Angelic chants.

All Angels have Halos and white, feathered wings.

All Angels are typically extremely fast and durable, however their strength can vary greatly from one to another.

The Angel race was created by the mysterious being known as Syriel, who is said to have created Ruell, the universe, itself, along with the other races, including the Demons.

Angels typically live up to twenty thousand years. However, the Ark Saints can live up to hundreds of thousands, and even potentially millions, of years.

Although there are many Angels in existence, the most prominent and high-ranking ones are the first ten, collectively known as the “Ten Ark Saints”. These are, in order from strongest to weakest: Kinuel, Rya, Zenuel, Hazel, Opal, Ganuel, Ariel, Tikel, Jenel, and Leni.

Two of the Saints, Opal and Tikel, had given up their Halo and wings, for varying reasons.

entries.name: Vak Lumen
entries.content:
Vak Lumen, also known as the Realm of Light, or the Angel Realm, is the Realm in which resides the Angel race. 

Vak Lumen is described as the place “beyond the skies”. It is a space that resembles the sky itself, composed of floating structures and tangible clouds. 

All Angels derive their power from Vak Lumen itself.

entries.name: Ruell, the Universe
entries.content:
Ruell is the name given to the universe, in which the Angel, Demon, and Earth Realms all reside.

Ruell is said to have been created by the mysterious being known as Syriel.

entries.name: Demons
entries.content:
Demons are beings who reside in Ars Ruen, also known as the Demon Realm, or the Realm of Darkness.

Demons are immortal and immensely powerful beings that directly rival Angels. They typically utilize Darkness as their main source of power. Fire manipulation is another typical ability that Demons can utilize.

All Demons typically harbor supernatural physical capabilities, being ten times faster, stronger, and more durable than Humans.

Demons, unlike Angels, have a naturally high healing factor. However, they cannot heal others. They also have the ability to use Demonic incantations for various purposes.

Demons all carry a black tattoo-like marking somewhere on their bodies, which can expand and spread when they use their true power. These markings, when activated, grant the user the ability to manipulate and change the shape and size of the affected body part. Demons can have the same or similar marking, but more unique markings are often signs of a more powerful Demon, or one with a rare and possibly extremely powerful ability.

Demons typically live up to fifteen thousand years. However, higher ranking Demons can typically live for far longer.

All Demons have tails, which can be different shapes and sizes. Demons all have seven hearts, though rarely, they can have up to ten.

Also unlike Angels, there are several subspecies of Demon: Outlandish types, Hōzan types, and Mugen types.

Outlandish Demons are unique in that they can freely utilize black matter manipulation, even using it in conjunction with their black markings to manipulate the shape and size of their body parts to a greater degree, making them among the more powerful of the species as a whole. 

Hōzan Demons are Demons who specialize in speed, being comparable to “ninjas” by Humans. They also utilize the abilities afforded to them by their Demonic markings with even greater finesse than other Demons. 

Mugen Demons, also called the Accursed Demons, are Demons who harbor white Demonic markings as opposed to the usual black, and cannot use the abilities normally granted via activating them. In exchange, Mugen type Demons have vastly higher physical capacities than other Demons, with strength, speed, stamina, durability and healing factors beyond the scope of their other kin. However, Mugen Demons have far shorter lifespans, only able to live until the age of three hundred, which, by Demon standards, is extremely young.

entries.name: Ars Ruen
entries.content:
Ars Ruen, also known as the Realm of Darkness, or the Demon Realm, is the Realm in which resides the Demon race. 

Ars Ruen is described as a desolate “place of nightmares”. It is a barren wasteland, though there are areas that are more prosperous than others.

Ars Ruen is split up into various nations and tribes, but all are united under the Demon King, Vesta.

The Royal Demon Castle is nestled in the very center of Ars Ruen.

All Demons derive their power from the Realm of Darkness itself.

entries.name: Earth
entries.content:
Earth, or Earth Realm, is the world in which Humans, along with various other races such as Orcs, Goblins, Dragons, Kitsune, etc. reside.

Earth consists of various nations and countries, though in recent times, the various races and Humans have managed to coexist peacefully.

entries.name: Void
entries.content:
Outside of Ruell, in a plane of existence of its very own, lies the Void.

It is an empty space, a zone of absolute nothingness, yet beings can spawn out of nowhere, and disappear just as easily. 

Anyone born in the Void is said to possess unimaginable power and abilities, possibly even higher than Syriel herself. However, very few even know about the Void or its inhabitants, and any information they do know is extremely limited.

Void beings have an aura that is undetectable by anyone within Ruell, including Angels and Demons.

Kinuel and Rya of the Ten Ark Saints, along with few members of the Outlandish Demon race, are the only beings aware of the existence of the Void.
